## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated in `tests/` (new manifest parsers, new detection logic, or bug fixes should
      all come with a test that would have failed before the change)
- [ ] `pytest tests/` passes locally
- [ ] `README.md` updated if this changes user-facing behavior (e.g. the "Supported manifests" table)
- [ ] No new default-on network calls, telemetry, or auto-actions — see `CONTRIBUTING.md` § Ground rules
